player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Givim yu muv olsem **[macro  micro]** (tu namba 0-8):
• *macro*  = usim mini-bodi yu pilai long en
• *micro* = usim skwea insait long mini-bodi
Eksempul `[7 8]` ➜ putim yu mak long mini-bodi 7, skwea 8, na
mekim yu opisitin pilai long mini-bodi 8 bihain.

Yu `{symbol}`.

board.current_board: Ol i mekim wok long en nau: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muv mas i go insait long fom [macro micro] wantaim namba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Olgeta indeks i mas stap namel long 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row or col i no stap long mak.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Ol i stap pinis long sel.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Man i pilai em bai go long narapela liklik plet.

game_action.played: Pleya {player_id} i pley long mikro bode {macro_idx}, sel {micro_idx} (ro {row}, kol {col}). Pleya {opponent_id} mas nau i pley long {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Man {player_id} i winim Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
